name: decision-assistant
description: Decision guardrail MCP server for AI coding

scripts.verify:determinism: npm run build && npx tsx scripts/verify_determinism.ts
scripts.verify:replay-protection: npm run build && npx tsx scripts/verify_replay_protection.ts
scripts.verify:receipt-lifecycle: npm run build && npx tsx scripts/verify_receipt_lifecycle.ts
scripts.verify:guardrail: npm run build && npx tsx scripts/verify_guardrail.ts
scripts.verify:decision-logs: npm run build && npx tsx scripts/verify_decision_logs.ts
scripts.verify:matrix:versioning: npm run build && node scripts/verify_version_alignment.mjs && node scripts/verify_schema_version_discipline.mjs && node scripts/verify_persistence_version_discipline.mjs
scripts.verify:matrix:contract: node scripts/verify_machine_contracts.mjs && npx tsx scripts/verify_guardrail.ts && npx tsx scripts/verify_determinism.ts && npx tsx scripts/verify_replay_protection.ts && npx tsx scripts/verify_receipt_lifecycle.ts && npx tsx scripts/verify_decision_logs.ts && node scripts/verify_error_semantics.mjs
scripts.verify:matrix:packaging: node scripts/verify_package_surface.mjs && node scripts/verify_npm_pack_contents.mjs && node scripts/verify_install_smoke.mjs && node scripts/verify_use_smoke.mjs
scripts.verify:matrix:persistence-reliability: node scripts/verify_persistence_migration.mjs && node scripts/verify_persistence_recovery.mjs && node scripts/verify_concurrent_consume.mjs && node scripts/verify_decision_log_integrity.mjs && node scripts/verify_sqlite_pragmas.mjs

scripts.release:gate: npm run build && npm run release:gate:postbuild
scripts.release:gate:v0.6:postbuild: npm run verify:matrix:persistence-reliability && npm run verify:matrix:recovery-guards
scripts.release:gate:v0.6: npm run build && npm run release:gate:postbuild && npm run release:gate:v0.6:postbuild
